no keyword declared: the UA control face, 13.3333px
font: inherit - the document's 16px sans-serif
font: initial - 16px Times, whatever the document asks for
font: unset - the same group as inherit, because every longhand of it inherits
font: inherit bold 12px Arial is invalid, so the UA face stays on this row
a textarea: the UA monospace face, then the document's sans-serif
